description: What a page at web.telegram.org may ask of the app, and nothing more: the userscript manager's commands and the updater's (gm_*, app_update_*), and what Telegram's own client asks of a desktop host, as it asks Telegram Air. No other page is granted anything. The whole origin and not /a/ alone: a call that arrives over Tauri's own protocol names its origin and no path.
